behavior.substitutable_unconstrained: Only the six fallback-eligible IDs may select a compatible configured llama lane; provenance records the owned refusal and the selected lane's actual fingerprint.
behavior.identity_pinned: Returns owned_decode_not_certified or the applicable typed refusal; never substitutes a model.
behavior.constrained: Never falls back to llama. Grammar-disabled responses retain underlying_owned_decode_refusal_id.
behavior.pre_dispatch_failures: Perform no worker dispatch and consume no crash budget.
behavior.consumer_compatibility: No refusal ID, response field, or microllm.oneshot contract is renamed, retyped, or reinterpreted by this slice.
